plugins.contactsPermission: Allow Khata to access your contacts to easily add customers and suppliers.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow Khata to access your camera to take photos of bills, receipts and documents.
plugins.microphonePermission: Allow Khata to record audio for voice notes and reminders.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow Khata to use your location for geotagged transactions and nearest store search.
plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Allow Khata to use your location for geotagged transactions and nearest store search.

plugins.faceIDPermission: Allow Khata to use biometric authentication for secure App Lock.

infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: Allow Khata to access your phone contacts to add customers and suppliers.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Allow Khata to use camera to capture bills, receipts and transaction proofs.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Allow Khata to record voice transaction notes.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Allow Khata to tag transaction and customer locations.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Allow Khata to tag transaction and customer locations.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Allow Khata to use Face ID for app security and vault unlock.
infoPlist.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: Allow Khata to connect to thermal receipt printers and POS devices.
